stops.name: Parque Natural Sierra de Baza
stops.detail: The Sierra de Baza Natural Park is situated to the north-east of the province of Granada, limiting with the province of Almería and forming with the reliefs of the Sierras de los Filabres the continuation to the east of the bethic range. Located in a semi-arid setting of the Hoya de Baza and characterized by rare rainfall and irregular distribution, the mountain massizo of the Sierra de Baza rises to exceed 2200 m. n. m., with the Calar of Santa Barbara with 2269 m n. n.. the summit of this natural park, which was declared a natural space protected by Act 2 / 1989 of 18 July 1989, approving the Inventary of Natural Protected Spaces of Andalucía and lays down additional measures for its protection, with a total extension of 53 649 ha, distributed between the terms of Gor of Valle, and of Zatra, and of the town.
